reading.title: 3D printer lab 1: Understanding a design task
reading.text: A designer visits the lab to compare printing methods. On one machine, a filament spool supplies the extruder, and the print head moves above the build plate. Melted material leaves through the nozzle. A stepper motor drives a belt along a guide rail, while a cooling fan moves air near the print. The LCD screen shows information about the job. The lab keeps PLA filament, ABS filament, PETG filament and nylon in separate storage areas. Resin belongs to a different printing process. The designer records the part names and asks about material differences before choosing a sample.
